board: Adafruit DPS310 Precision Barometric Pressure / Altitude Sensor breakout (#4494, STEMMA QT)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator, circuit board, footprint). The driver uses command mode with the datasheet's coefficient decoding, table 9 scale factors and the sec. 4.9 compensation formulas; the sim encodes raw values with the same formulas. The board's SCK/SDI pins are named SCL/SDA because the simulator only recognises those names for I2C.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://github.com/adafruit/Adafruit-DPS310-PCB/blob/master/Adafruit%20DPS310.brd (silkscreen order VIN, 3Vo, GND, SCK, SDO, SDI, CS) and https://learn.adafruit.com/adafruit-dps310-precision-barometric-pressure-sensor/pinouts
